labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: Standalone write path
labels.what: One standalone node, writes only: the Phase 9 build, in which each write held the store's lock through its fsync, so writes from different clients never shared one; then this build, in which concurrent writes share the engine's group commit and its fsync (internal/kvstore).
